resources.string: Android 17 requires local network permission to reach the WHUT private-IP portal. Allow local portal access to continue. No Wi-Fi scan or location is used.
WHUT uses HTTP: your password travels without transport encryption. Keystore protects storage only. Use only on a trusted WHUT Wi-Fi network. Protocol checks cannot prove the server’s identity.
